name: The Mother of Pearls
source:
One night, a mother tells her daughter a story. It's a story about a mermaid who came to land for the sake of love. She found her human, but finding happiness won't be so simple...

[From [url=https://midge-the-tree.itch.io/the-mother-of-pearls]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一天晚上，一位母亲给女儿讲了一个故事。这是一个关于美人鱼为了爱情来到陆地的故事。她找到了自己的人类，但找到幸福并不是那么简单……

[来自[url=https://midge-the-tree.itch.io/the-mother-of-pearls]Itch.io[/url]]
